version.description: Index format version. `1` is this one.

plugins.description: Every plugin anyone has submitted, bundled ones included.

Entry.description:
One plugin in the index.

 Deliberately small: a name, where to get it, and who to ask about it. Any
 field that would need maintaining — a download count, a rating, a mirror of
 the code — is a field that goes stale and misleads.

description.description: One line. Shown in the list.

id.description: The `[language].id` from its manifest. Unique in the index.

git.description:
What `tinkerpad plugin install` is given. Absent for a bundled plugin,
 which is already here.

languages.description: The languages it adds, for searching. Usually one.

maintainer.description: Who to open an issue with.

verified_with.description: The last TinkerPad version its `plugin check` was seen to pass on.

bundled.description:
Shipped with TinkerPad. Listed so the index is the whole catalogue
 rather than only the parts that aren't here.
